result_text:
`all_files.zip` now finds its entries by the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. The `DataExporter*` tests in the `reports` module pass. I didn't add a test for the renamed case, so that case itself is untested.

The fix is in `aspectFileLists` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It used to read five hard-coded file names, so a renamed aspect pointed at a file that didn't exist. That threw an exception, which the surrounding `catch` swallowed, and `git-history.zip` is written after it in the same block. It now builds the names with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(...)` from the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects of the configuration. That is the same naming the loose `aspect_*.txt` files are written under.

With the default configuration the entries and their order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. I also updated the Javadoc on the method, which described the old hard-coded names.
